metaDesc: When should you visit Koh Samui? A month-by-month comparison of rain, sun and prices — plus the key fact that Samui's rain pattern runs opposite to the Andaman coast (Phuket, Krabi).

h1:
Best Time to Visit
Koh Samui?
intro: Koh Samui sits on the Gulf coast, and its rain pattern runs on a completely different schedule than Phuket and Krabi on the Andaman coast. A lot of first-timers assume Thailand's rainy season hits everywhere at once — here's the honest month-by-month breakdown.
quickAnswerHtml: Short answer: Koh Samui is on the Gulf coast, and its heaviest rain falls October to December — the opposite of Phuket and Krabi on the Andaman coast, which are heaviest May-October. January through September is mostly clear and good for the beach on Samui, except late in that window it's worth checking the forecast before booking.

blocks.html: Short answer: Koh Samui sits on the Gulf coast (along with Koh Phangan and Koh Tao), and it rains on a completely different schedule than the Andaman coast (Phuket, Krabi, Phi Phi) — Samui's heaviest rain falls October through December, right when Phuket is usually clear. January through September is mostly clear and sunny on Samui, great for beach days and diving — one real advantage over the Andaman coast, which gets its heaviest rain mid-year.

When Phuket is rainy, Samui's often still good

blocks.html: Thailand doesn't rain everywhere at once. The Andaman coast (Phuket, Krabi, Phi Phi) gets its heaviest rain May through October, while the Gulf coast (Samui, Koh Phangan, Koh Tao) gets its heaviest rain October through December. So if you're planning a Phuket trip and it looks rainy, Samui might be a better bet in some of those months (July-September especially) — or vice versa. If you're planning to visit Samui October through December, check the forecast close to your travel dates, since some years bring storms strong enough to suspend the ferry.

items: Want the most reliable clear skies — come January to March, dry and cool
Phuket's rainy but you still want a beach — try Samui July to September, often still clear
On a budget — October to December is cheaper, but check the forecast before booking ferries or flights

faq.q: Do Koh Samui and Phuket have rain at the same time?
faq.a: No. Samui is on the Gulf coast and gets its heaviest rain October-December, while Phuket is on the Andaman coast and gets its heaviest rain May-October. If one is rainy, the other may have better weather.

faq.q: Can you visit Koh Samui in the rainy season?
faq.a: October through December is Samui's heaviest rain and roughest seas, and some years bring storms strong enough to suspend the ferry — check the forecast close to your travel dates before booking.

faq.q: When are Koh Samui hotel prices cheapest?
faq.a: October through December, its low season due to rain. Prices drop noticeably, but plan for the possibility of rough weather affecting your trip.
